claims.statement: A client_credentials request to the Adobe IMS token endpoint returns an access_token with token_type "bearer" and an expires_in value in seconds; access tokens usually expire in 24 hours and the documentation recommends caching them until expiry.

sources.supports: Sample response shows access_token, token_type bearer and expires_in; no refresh token is used for OAuth Server-to-Server credentials.
Access tokens usually expire in 24 hours; expires_in is in seconds; integrations should cache tokens until expiry.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Adobe documentation read for this candidate gives no prefix, alphabet, length or other format rule for this value; any example in it is a placeholder or a public identifier. Not researched beyond existence.

The pages read do not say whether the access token is a structured token (for example a JWT) or opaque, so no prefix or segment shape is recorded. It is also not established whether a token from this credential is distinguishable from an access token issued through user authentication.
